intro: Omaha's non-climate 10x10 street rate is $88/month, down 2.2% from a year earlier (StorageCafe, September 2026). The climate-controlled 10x10 figure on the same StorageCafe page is about $109. StorageUnitCosts does not publish this city, and Storage Stats has no market page for it, so that StorageCafe figure is the advertised rate. Once the move-in special ends and the first existing-customer increase lands, the six-month average sits above that street rate.
data_asof: Sep 2026 (StorageCafe street rates); no StorageUnitCosts city page; no Storage Stats market page

units.notes: Locker / closet size. Fixed fees dominate the true cost at this size. StorageCafe street rate $40 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$47.
Walk-in closet; studio overflow. StorageCafe street rate $59 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$73. No reliable lowest-promo figure published for this size (gap).

Most rented size. City street rate $88, down 2.2% from a year earlier (StorageCafe industry statistics, Sep 2026). StorageUnitCosts does not publish this city. Storage Stats does not publish a market page for this city. Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$109.
Two-bedroom contents. StorageCafe street rate $111 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$136.
Three-bedroom home or a car. StorageCafe street rate $128 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$166.

local_tips: StorageCafe lists Downtown Omaha (~$73), Park East (~$87), Raven Oaks - Woodhurst (~$93) among the cheaper areas for a standard unit. Dodge Park - Wyman Heights (~$261) is among the highest.
Omaha has about 78 facilities and 7.4 sq ft of storage per person (StorageCafe).
Extra Space's published admin fee is $50 on StorageUnitCosts' fee notes, higher than our $29 default; adjust the calculator if your facility charges more.
